value.rationale: The motivating paper itself isolates projected perturbations as a meaningful structural refinement for topological equivalence but does not carry that refinement into its Hölder theorem. Keeping the budgets separate yields a reusable criterion rather than an arbitrary parameter slice, and the symmetric one-sided specialization increases the sufficient perturbation range by the exact factor 2(1+alpha), a substantial two-to-fourfold improvement.
